If the system has specific behaviors for edge cases or exceptions, these should be added to the test cases accordingly. The "[] should be non-empty" requirement was interpreted as a positive test case to ensure that the feature under test is present and functional. The test cases have been designed to cover the specified requirements, including boundary values and negative paths where applicable. The test suite is grounded in the requirement text and includes both positive and negative test cases where relevant.
